name: Pugilist’s Robe
body:
Price 8,000 GP (MAGIC), 12,000 GP (SILVER OR COLD IRON), 16,000 GP (ADAMANTINE); Slot body; CL 5th; Weight 5 lbs.; Aura faint transmutation

DESCRIPTION

This stylish robe will alter its appearance to fit the personality of its wearer as well as resizing itself if needed. If a medium or small creature wears this robe, they treat their unarmed strikes as though they were 1 size larger for the purpose of how much damage they deal. They also treat their unarmed strikes as magic for the purpose of penetrating damage reduction. Other robes can be found which allow their wearer to also treat their unarmed strikes as silver, cold iron, or adamantine for the purpose of penetrating damage reduction.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 4,000 GP (MAGIC), 6,000 GP (COLD IRON OR SILVER), 8,000 GP (ADAMANTINE); Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells enlarge person, magic weapon
